{"id":2046712232,"question_id":50,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 6 days","timestamp":1782470098,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2046712232/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Pow(x, n)","memory":"8.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    double myPow(double x, int n) {\n        double power = 1;\n        ll exp = (n < 0) ? -(ll)n : (ll)n;\n        \n        if(n < 0) x = 1.0 / x;\n\n        while(exp != 0)\n        {\n            if(exp & 1) power *= x;\n            x *= x;\n            exp >>= 1;\n        }\n        return power;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"powx-n","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2230}
